summary: Completed backend+frontend migration regression on public URL. Added/ran direct Stripe config-gating tests and extensive MOCKED Stripe webhook/checkout unit tests. Verified removed generation routes return 404, PDFs serve valid bytes, shop/admin/cart flows work, and checkout correctly fails with 503 in current keyless setup while cart state persists.

integration_issues.issue: frontend.err.log still reports a VisualEditsPlugin lookup to /node_modules/@emergentbase/visual-edits/dist/visual-edit-overlay.js (ENOENT). App behavior is not blocked, but this indicates residual Emergent-specific runtime hook/noise in dev startup path.

action_items: Investigate/remove the residual VisualEditsPlugin @emergentbase overlay lookup from frontend dev startup path (if truly app-owned; if platform-owned, document as non-app infrastructure artifact).
When real Stripe test credentials are available (valid sk_test_/rk_test_ + STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET), retest hosted checkout completion/webhook on public preview.
critical_code_review_comments: payments.py correctly enforces webhook_secret() before session creation, preventing unsigned-payment acceptance and false-positive checkout starts.
payment status is webhook-authoritative: checkout/status polling validates session but does not mark paid, which matches required security behavior.
Removed routes for image generation/regeneration are no longer reachable (404), and admin products uses View product links (no regenerate UI).

success_rate.backend: 100% pass on executed suite (75 passed, 4 skipped by config gating)
success_rate.frontend: 97% of requested flows verified (known Stripe setup blocker respected)

seed_data_creation: No new persistent seed data created. Existing TEST_ users from previous suites were reused/created by tests as needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL from frontend/.env was used. Checkout currently returns 503 by design because direct Stripe secrets are not configured; cart remains intact and error is shown. MOCKED Stripe tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_payments_mocked.py and use real Stripe signature construction with HMAC headers in tests only.
rca of the issue: RCA (non-blocking): frontend.err.log contains a VisualEditsPlugin ENOENT looking for @emergentbase/visual-edits overlay. Repo search shows no @emergentbase dependency in manifests/config and node_modules/@emergentbase is absent; likely stale/indirect dev tooling hook rather than active app runtime dependency. Repro: check /var/log/supervisor/frontend.err.log after frontend start. Mitigation: trace CRACO/webpack plugin chain at runtime and remove/disable any residual visual-edit plugin registration, or document as managed-preview infrastructure artifact if external to app code.
